newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil firm, Italy buys more.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil firm, Italy buys more.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil was firmer on Wednesday amid good demand from Italy and strong prices in the U.S., traders said.
An Italian utility was heard having bought this week a Cameroonian cargo from a trader, and a low sulphur Spanish cargo at around $10 over the quoted high cif.

A U.K. refiner sold a North Sea straight-run cargo to another U.K player at $147.30 cif NWE, and values were assessed a couple of dollars higher late. Another refiner bought an Abidjan cargo earlier in the week.
